info.title: Meshway control API
info.description: Durable control-plane identity, public-key associations and configuration intent. Receipts mean saved only; not runtime peer proof, connectivity or tunnel health.

AgentNodeResponse.description: Also lets a pending local enrollment recover its server-assigned node ID.

expected_epoch.description: Pin the initial epoch read across retries; never refresh after a conflict.

ClaimOwnerRequest.description: Bootstrap proof comes from adminBearer; existing accounts must prove their own session.

probe_fresh.description: A recent authenticated control-nonce probe, not merely a control heartbeat.

reason.description: Sanitized peer-local outcome, independent of global reconcile state.

current.description: Matches the current node-scoped revision/digest and node is active.

stale.description: Not current, never reported, or receive age >= stale_after_seconds.

CreateEnrollmentTokenResponse.description: The token is revealed only once, in this creation response.

initial_listener.description: Initial intent only: node_id MUST be empty and is bound by enrollment.

EnrollAgentRequest.description:
Persist the proposed random credential before sending this request. Retry
with the same enrollment token, credential, name and enrollment version.

FlowQuery.description:
Internet country is a preview hint, not automatic geolocation. Mesh country
and source country always come from the active-node inventory.

epoch.description: Zero means this node has never acquired a runtime lease.

HeartbeatRequest.description: Node identity is derived exclusively from the node bearer credential.

historical.description: Always true: a retained measurement never asserts present connectivity.

capacity_trimmed.description: The requested window intersects the conservative capacity-trimmed range.

capacity_trimmed_before.description:
Conservative source-wide capacity watermark (all peers). Some earlier
events were evicted; it does not describe offline time or continuous coverage.

retention_from.description: Current TTL floor. This is a maximum age, not a promise of continuous data.

channel_associations.description:
Runtime returns exact channel metadata only with successful proof. A
timeout leaves this empty rather than racing a separate registry read.
Exactly one association for success, zero for timeout.

failure_reasons.description:
One sanitized attempt failure for Failed, otherwise empty. This is not
a network loss classification; local send failures are kept separate.

measured_at.description: Actual probe invocation start; retained unchanged through queue/retry.

rtt_us.description: Integer microseconds, measured using a monotonic clock, never HTTP RTT.

sampler_generation.description: Local sampler generation, not an assertion of physical channel identity.

password.description:
Controller enforces 12–1024 UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema string lengths count
Unicode code points, so a byte minimum must not be emitted as minLength.

LoginResponse.description: Returned only after durable session commit; the Web server keeps it private.

advertised_endpoints.description: Explicit announcement, not proof of reachability. Empty means no dial endpoint.

compiled_capability_available.description: False is retained intent awaiting a compatible identity/capability report.

ManagedVlessMaterial.description: No Debug: serialization is permitted only on the node-authenticated endpoint.

private_key_pem.description: Only listener owner receives this; dialers receive null.

server_name.description: Certificate name and client verification name, independent of HTTP Host.

path.description: Exact ordered full path, including source and destination. No repeats.

policy.description: Saved source intent, retained even when references become invalid.

MeshNode.description: Public active-node inventory; country is administrator-managed metadata.

MeshPathAuthorization.description:
Internal compiled path authorization. Its JSON remains `{ "grants": [...] }`
so schema-version-1 NodeDataplane remains byte-contract compatible.

NetworkSnapshot.description: Saved intent at the network configuration revision. Address pools are immutable.

NodeDataplane.description: One coherent global revision, projected for the authenticated node.

membership_id.description: Null means legacy-unassigned; tags remain ordinary node attributes.

NodeSummary.description: Durable control-plane identity. Last contact is not tunnel health.

QueryLatencyHistoryRequest.description: Raw events for one directed pair. Exclusive row cursor, not an offset.

epoch.description: Reuses the authenticated managed runtime's acquired epoch, not a new identity.

sequence.description: Independent monotonic discovery report sequence within that epoch.

SourceSelector.description: Empty dimensions are wildcards; dimensions combine with AND, members with OR.

observed_at.description: Repeated reports preserve these times; retransmission is not renewal.

observer.description: Explicit numeric STUN observer endpoint, not a Meshway peer identity.

generation.description: Public process-local runtime generation and socket ordinal.

resource_id.description: Controller listener/candidate ID, never a private runtime token.
